title: Clearing a named root fails repeatedly: durability_pending and 'Engram control reached EOF' with a live control process
outcome: Clearing a named root on a held claim completes or refuses with an accurate reason and a recovery that works, and control failures have an identified cause.
acceptance: The cause of the control EOF and late reply responses is established from source and supported records, or recorded as unknown with what's missing; timing alone isn't a cause.

A clear on a held claim converges or is refused with a remedy that works, shown by a behaviour test that fails before any fix, a review pair with no Medium or higher, and the normal gate; no fence is loosened.
